data.one_liner: A property-based testing framework for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Glados runs tests by generating a wide variety of random inputs to break defined properties and simplifies failing inputs into concise error reports.
use_when: You want to test code against a wide variety of automatically generated inputs.
You want to write properties that should always hold true instead of concrete examples.
avoid_when: You only want to write traditional unit tests with concrete inputs.
strengths: Writes fewer tests while testing a wide variety of inputs.
Concise error reports that shrink failing inputs.
Easily customizable input generators for custom data classes.
weaknesses: Requires shifting mindset to property-based thinking rather than traditional examples.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: For standard unit and widget testing with concrete inputs.

alternatives.name: mocktail
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need mocking and stubbing capabilities instead of property-based testing.
